LinkedAccount.title: LinkedAccount
LinkedAccount.description: Represents an employee or manager account synced to Google Cloud Firestore for cross-device account linking and role-based permission enforcement.

userCode.description: Unique account code matching the document ID (e.g., USR-SD-1001).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the manager/owner who created and manages this account.

linkedUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the employee linked to this account.

fullName.description: Full display name of the employee or manager.

username.description: Login username identifier for the employee.

role.description: Assigned job role (e.g., مدير النظام, محاسب خزنة ومبيعات).

permissions.description: Comma-separated list of screen/module permissions assigned by the manager.

serverSyncToken.description: Unique cloud synchronization token for linking employee devices.

active.description: Whether the employee account is currently active.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ClusterMember.title: ClusterMember
ClusterMember.description: Authoritative server-side RBAC membership document keyed by Firebase Auth UID inside an ERP cluster.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

emailKey.description: Sanitized email directory document key used during self-claim.

branch.description: Assigned branch or ALL for multi-branch administrators.

permissions.description: Granular module and action permission tokens.

active.description: Whether the member is permitted to access the cluster.

EmailDirectoryEntry.title: EmailDirectoryEntry
EmailDirectoryEntry.description: Admin/Manager pre-provisioned verified email binding for zero-trust Google Sign-In claim.

roleKey.description: Authoritative RBAC role assigned by Admin/Manager.

active.description: Whether the directory binding is active.

/linked_accounts/{accountCode}.description: Stores cloud-linked user accounts and manager-assigned employee permissions.

/erp_clusters/{clusterCode}/cluster_memb.description: Server-side authoritative RBAC directory keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/erp_clusters/{clusterCode}/email_direct.description: Pre-provisioned email-to-role bindings allowing verified Google users to claim their assigned membership safely.

schema.description: Enterprise cloud ERP central documents for Android, Web, and Windows Desktop clients.

/erp_clusters/{clusterCode}/{collectionN.description: Enterprise central database synchronization cluster connecting Android, Web, and Windows clients.
